description: This file implements table select functionality for Drupal, including behaviors for selecting all checkboxes, range selection, and toggling row classes based on checkbox states.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Initializes table select behavior on specified context.

methods.name: Drupal.tableSelect
methods.description: Handles the select all checkbox, individual checkbox toggling, and range selection within a table.

methods.name: Drupal.tableSelectRange
methods.description: Selects or deselects a range of table rows based on checkbox interactions.
